subject: Banking
title: Danske Bank's $230 Billion Scandal
description: A fast breakdown of Danske Bank's $230 Billion Scandal for builders.

hook.text: $230 billion in suspicious money flowed through Danske Bank's Estonian branch.

buildup.text: From 2007 to 2015, Danske Bank's tiny Estonian branch processed transactions from Russian oligarchs and shell companies.

discovery.text: A single whistleblower, Howard Wilkinson, reported the suspicious flows. Management dismissed his concerns for years.

twist.text: Danske Bank's CEO resigned, its stock dropped 50%, and Denmark's reputation as a clean financial center was destroyed.

climax.text: A small branch in Estonia laundered more money than Denmark's entire GDP.

punchline.text: $230 billion laundered. One whistleblower. Years of ignored warnings.

quiz.question: How much suspicious money flowed through Danske Bank's Estonian branch?
